questions.question: Which of the following is NOT related to goals of Fundamental Duties of Indian Citizens?
Which Fundamental Right guarantees protection of interests of the minorities in the matter of their language, script or culture?
Which executive system is present in India?
If a citizen is helping the government in protecting the monuments in his/her area, which of the following fundamental duties is he/she performing?
questions.option_4: Valuing and preserving the rich heritage and culture

questions.question: From which of the following countries was the concept of the Fundamental Duties borrowed?
Which of the following is NOT an important function of the Supreme Court?
questions.option_1: It acts to check on executive authorities and enforce the rule of law
questions.option_3: It maintains of land records and revenue collection
questions.option_4: It is the protector and guarantor of fundamental rights

questions.question: The Fundamental Rights Sub-Committee of the Constituent Assembly was headed by ____________.
Which of the following Fundamental Rights entails trafficking of human beings and forced labour?
Which of the following is NOT considered as a Fundamental Duty?
questions.option_1: To develop the scientific temper, humanism and the spirit of inquiry and reform
questions.option_2: To value and preserve the rich heritage of our composite culture
questions.option_3: To uphold and protect the sovereignty, unity and integrity of India

questions.question: Which of the following states has bicameral (two houses) state legislature?

Who among the following elect(s) the presiding officer of the Vidhan Sabha in India?
Who can exercise a casting vote in the case of an equality of votes in Lok Sabha?

On which date did Punjab abolish the Legislative Council?
